description: Algorithm parameters and thresholds for river morphology change analysis

water_extraction.description: NDWI/MNDWI threshold for water body extraction. Water pixels have index >= threshold.

centerline.description: Voronoi-based medial axis extraction from boundary sample points

transects.description: Perpendicular transects generated along centerline at regular intervals

migration.description: Migration measured as distance between shoreline intersections along transects

quality_codes.1: high - clean intersection, single shoreline crossing
quality_codes.2: medium - small migration or minor complexity
quality_codes.4: invalid - no intersection or processing error

hotspots.description: Transects with migration distance exceeding percentile threshold

references: Pavelsky, T.M. & Smith, L.C. (2008). RivWidth: A MATLAB algorithm to calculate river widths from remotely sensed imagery. IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters.
Isikdogan, F. et al. (2017). RivMap: Automatic river width extraction from Landsat imagery. IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium.
Fisher, G.B. et al. (2013). Global assessment of river deltas. Nature Geoscience.
